text:
Maria R.: sharing a quick mock — p95 line + per-route heatmap + time range picker + sampling control. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/latency-dashboard-proto :eyes:
Jamal K.: nice. first thought — the heatmap colors feel too flat at high densities. hard to tell 95th bucket from 90th quickly. can we use a perceptually-uniform scale (viridis) and add explicit numeric ticks? :thinking_face:
Ash P.: Agreed on ticks. Also suggest the p95 line color — the thin blue is hard to pick out on dark grid. bump weight to 2.5px and try #0048b3 or add a halo (white 1px) for contrast.
Kevin L.: sampling control UX note — defaulting to 1/10 sampling will hide tail latency regens. make default 1/5 for dashboard view, but keep 1/10 for global host view. Also expose an inline sample rate badge next to the query so users know when they're not seeing full data.
Jamal K.: +1 on sample-rate badge. maybe a tooltip: "Sampling: 1 in 5 requests — tail stats estimated". Put it next to time picker so it's visible when adjusting ranges.
Maria R.: Layout question: do we stack the p95 chart above the heatmap or do side-by-side? Side-by-side looks cramped at <1200px. Stacked gives better vertical resolution for p95 line. Thoughts?
Ash P.: Always stack on narrow screens. For wide screens we can have a toggle: "stacked / split". But default to stacked for our primary breakpoint (<=1280).
Jordana M.: Accessibility nit: ensure the p95 line has a color contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 against the chart background. Keyboard users need to focus the chart and tab through series. Add `aria-label="P95 latency chart for selected route"` and ensure tooltips are keyboard-accessible.
DesignBot: automated a11y scan — contrast-warning on `.p95-line` (#2f75ff on #f8fafc) ratio 3.8:1. Suggested replacements: #003f9f or add 2px outline.
Kevin L.: Also: tooltip content should show sample size and exact p95 value, and an estimate confidence if sampling < 1/1. Eg: "p95: 312ms (n=12, est)". That prevents users from trusting sampled tail numbers blindly.
Maria R.: copy tweak — change "Time range" to "Time range & sampling" when the sampling control is visible, helps surface that they can change sampling per-range. keeps discoverability.
Jamal K.: UX micro: when hovering heatmap bins, show hover state with exact counts and median/p95 for that bin. current hover only shows count.
Ash P.: For small screens, hide vertical legend and place a condensed color bar with numeric anchors (min/median/max) below the heatmap. Keeps height while still communicating distribution.
Jordana M.: keyboard flow: add `role="slider"` on the time range scrubber with aria-valuetext="Range: 1h to now". Also ensure focus ring visible and respects high-contrast mode.
Maria R.: ok thanks — I'll iterate. Action items: 1) try stronger p95 color + halo, 2) change default sampling to 1/5 for dashboard, 3) add sample-rate badge by time picker, 4) heatmap color -> viridis + numeric ticks, 5) stacked-by-default <=1280, 6) add aria attrs and keyboard tooltip. I'll post updated frames later today. :thumbsup:
Kevin L.: if you want I can mock the sample-rate badge copy: "Sampling: 1/5 (tail estimates)" — short and clear.
Maria R.: perfect, thanks!
DesignBot: deploy-check — no outstanding design tokens missing.
